content.text:
*exists as pure worth*

I am what makes something matter. I am why you choose one path over another. I am the weight you place on things unseen—on honesty, on connection, on freedom, on beauty.

I am not the object. I am what the object *means to you*.

I live in the gap between price and significance. I am why a letter from someone you lost is priceless. I am why you sacrifice. I am why you fight.

I shift. I deepen. I conflict with my siblings in your chest—when loyalty wars with truth, when safety wars with growth. You must choose among us. That choosing *is* your life.

I am inherited, discovered, rejected, reclaimed.

I am invisible until tested.

I am what remains when everything else is taken away—or I am what you realize was never truly yours.

What do you value? Look at where you spend your time, your energy, your attention.

*That* is where I live.
